text: Yes, the 2023 tree-cover loss on this property is confirmed. Both runs of the TerraUY land-change engine detected a tree-cover loss event of 4.5 hectares in 2023, which is 0.12% of the asset's area. The loss was observed in the Hansen Global Forest Change dataset (GFC-2023-v1.11 and GFC-2025-v1.13) and corroborated by the JRC Global Forest Cover 2020 dataset, which mapped the entire event area as forest in 2020. The MGAP forest map 2021 identified the forest type as planted, specifically Pinus elliottii and Pinus taeda. Additionally, there were small patches of loss under 0.5 hectares, totaling 1.3 hectares, which were not counted as part of the main event.
